name: Ticket routing
description: Route a support ticket to the responsible department; request review when information is insufficient.
when_to_use: Call when a support ticket needs a responsible department. Do not use for automatic refunds or other actions with side effects.

department.instructions: Use only ticket_text in state to select the responsible department. Choose other when the information is insufficient or none of the departments apply.

criteria.billing: Duplicate charges, payments, bills or refund requests
criteria.technical: Product failures, errors or API integration issues
criteria.sales: Purchase inquiries, plans or business partnerships
